notes.title: Introducing KIWI
notes.content:
Not everyone is a fan of handholding in video games, some of you prefer to explore and figure out things on their own.

Because of that we came up with [b]KIWI[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30296752/656ae5f266978383e5e069f0b9381f79a3d653df.png[/img]

[h1]KIWI[/h1]

[b]KIWI [/b]is your personal AI companion. She'll be with you from the very start and is ready to help you on your path to become a warden.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30296752/57cbf33c61fabbc46c1af98f1856e49602044498.png[/img]

At any time you'll be able to ask her for advice. Want to know how your gladiator is doing? Or where to go next to progress in your quest? Just ask KIWI and she'll be happy to oblige and help.

We've got the idea for KIWI during the process of adding tutorial like parts to the game. They break immersion, if you replay the game you get annoyed by them and some prefer having none at all. 

But due the complexity of the game we can't just have one skippable tutorial at the very beginning. As you make your way through the arena, things change and new mechanics appear.

KIWI is our solution for those problems and yes, she has a bit of a personality.

We hope you're looking forward to meet KIWI and stay tuned for more news very soon!

- Kaliyo
